Equipment loan: 2x 18TB portable arrays (migration staging)

Resolution: Loaned from IT cage, seal numbers 44817 and 44818. Couriered to the Glattbrugg colo cage Thursday 9 Oct for the migration.
- [2025-10-14 09:02] june.okada: Returned by the colo tech Monday 13 Oct 18:20. Seals 44817 and 44818 intact. Closing.

Garage barrier log shows wrong times

Resolution: Parking reimbursement check found barrier times one hour off against receipts. Landlord (Parkhaus Stickerei AG) confirms: the barrier system clock stayed on winter time after 30 March. Their letter of 03.04 went to all tenants. Not our system; they say it corrects itself on 26 October at the latest.
- [2025-10-27 08:55] dessie.moran: Checked a few entries from this week against receipts, times match now.

Sound carries between 3F-4 and the quiet room

Resolution: Door gap. Draught excluder fitted. The quiet room is still not quiet.

Sound transmission between 2F-3 and 2F-4

Requester reports that conversation in meeting room 2F-3 is clearly audible in office 2F-4, and vice versa.

Facilities assessment (2023-05-19): the partition between 2F-3 and 2F-4 is single-stud with no acoustic insulation — it was erected during the 2019 fit-out to subdivide what was originally one room, and does not extend to the structural deck. Speech at normal conversational volume is intelligible through it. Remediation requires taking the wall back to studs; quoted at CHF 14,200. Deferred pending budget.

Note appended 2024-02-02 (june.okada): Please stop booking 2F-3 for anything confidential. I have said this. I will keep saying it.

- [2024-09-30 10:12] june.okada: Raised again in the facilities review. Still deferred.
- [2025-11-14 09:05] june.okada: 2F-3 assigned to the external consultant from today, for the duration. Flagging FAC-330 to her. (No response.)
